verdict.rationale: Productboard's core workflow centers on linking feedback to feature ideas: feedback can be associated with users/companies and connected to features/components in a single searchable repository, with automatic insight detection linking feedback to related feature ideas, and the feature/initiative/prioritization tooling (plus MCP/API access) lets a PM turn that feedback into a prioritized, actionable initiative or feature. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end hands-on walkthrough or independent case study showing a single feedback item being converted into a task/initiative, and clearer UI-level (non-API) documentation of the conversion step.
